cards.name: Liliana's Other Contract // Liliana's Undead Minion

faces.name: Liliana's Other Contract
faces.oracleText:
When Liliana's Other Contract enters the battlefield, you draw three cards and you lose 3 life.
If you would lose the game, instead exile Liliana's Other Contract, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.

faces.name: Liliana's Undead Minion
faces.oracleText:
You can't lose the game.
+1: Each opponent loses 1 life.
−4: Destroy target creature.

faces.name: Liliana's Reaver
faces.oracleText:
Deathtouch
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card and you create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

faces.name: Liliana's Scorn
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Liliana, Death Mage, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

faces.name: Liliana's Scrounger
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, you may put a loyalty counter on a Liliana planeswalker you control.

faces.name: Liliana's Shade
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

faces.name: Liliana's Specter
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card.

faces.name: Liliana's Spoils
faces.oracleText:
Target opponent discards a card.
Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a black card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Liliana's Standard Bearer
faces.oracleText:
Flash
When this creature enters, draw X cards, where X is the number of creatures that died under your control this turn.
